sourceInterpretations: OpenAPI nullable:true permits explicit null in Fin, including enums whose published value list omits null; actual venue null behavior remains read-only live evidence pending.
Funding oneOf object scopes omit required discriminator keys/additionalProperties; meaningful method/network/group and status variants use the native documented discriminator.
Legacy native string/integer/number unions overlap; Fin accepts equivalent exact text through normalized anyOf without inventing numeric precision.
